needLogin: Sign in to calendar share before adding subscriptions.

connectionIcon.openAccount: Click to open Calendar share tab

identity.title: Calendar share
identity.help: Sign in to the public calendar-share server. Use the other tabs to publish and subscribe; Timeline only displays and filters.
identity.urlHelp: Default is https://subscribe.devents.tech. Tokens are encrypted on this machine; the UI never talks to that origin directly.
identity.timezoneHelp: Pinned household clock for floating recurring series. Prefills your current city; it does not follow Windows when you travel.
identity.timezonePending: The last public-server timezone update did not finish. You can retry when connected.

filter.title: Subscriptions
filter.loggedOut: Sign in to calendar share on the Calendar share tab before using this filter. Local sources still work.
filter.offline: Calendar share is unreachable. Subscriptions stay disabled until it reconnects. Local sources still work.

listFilter.placeholder: Filter by handle, slug, or name

published.needLogin: Sign in to calendar share before publishing or unpublishing.
published.missingWorkset: Local workset deleted; the public calendar is still up.
published.grantsEmpty: Private group — add handles in Settings so others can subscribe

form.help: Confirm uploads this workset now. Later event changes follow the toolbar Auto-update interval (minimum 1 minute). Turn it off to push only with the card refresh icon. Use the trash icon to unpublish.
form.catalogHelp: Cover and description are copied from this workset when you upload. Change them on the workset card.
form.generalWarning: The General workset includes unfiled events. Confirm nothing private should be published.
form.slugHelp: Remote path looks like handle/slug. 1–64 characters; start with a letter or digit; then letters, digits, dot, underscore, or hyphen.
form.slugInvalid: Slug must be 1–64 characters; start with a letter or digit; then letters, digits, dot, underscore, or hyphen.
form.publicHelp: Search shows four badges: Public, Public busy, Private, and Private busy. Private is not listed in the directory — add handles below. Grant Details or Private busy controls what added handles see in search (exact match); this is separate from the listing badge.
form.grantsTitle: Who can subscribe to this private group calendar
form.grantsHelp: Add a handle to allow subscribe; remove a grant, then confirm again to revoke access. This is not a shareable password.
form.grantsClosedHelp: This calendar is a private group. Only handles you add here can subscribe via handle/slug.

published.listRefreshPending: Uploaded. The list will refresh shortly.

search.pathHint: Private group calendars: paste handle/slug. The publisher must add your handle on My published.
search.rejectOwn: You cannot subscribe to your own calendar.
search.noGrant: No access. Ask the publisher to add your handle on My published.
